Ἐμμανουήλ.long: Emmanuel, a Messianic title derived from Isaiah 7:14 = God with us.
Ἐμμανουήλ.sd: God with us; Emmanuel, a name of Christ
Ἐμμανουήλ.as:
† Ἐμμανουήλ, ὁ (Heb. עִמָּנוּ אֵל, Is 7:14),
Immanuel: Mt 1:23(LXX).†

ἐμπαίζω.as:
ἐμ-παίζω
[in LXX for עָלַל hithp., שָׂחַק, etc. ;]
= Attic προσ-, καταπαίζω,
to mock at, mock (Hdt.): c. dat., Mt 27:29, 31, Mk 15:20, Lk 14:2922:6323:36; pass., Mt 2:16, Lk 18:32; absol., Mt 20:1927:41, Mk 10:3415:31, Lk 23:11.†

ἔμπροσθεν.long: in front, before the face; sometimes made a subst. by the addition of the article: in front of, before the face of.
ἔμπροσθεν.sd: in front of (in place (literally or figuratively) or time)
ἔμπροσθεν.kj: against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of
ἔμπροσθεν.as:
ἔμ-προσθεν
adv.
of place (in cl. also of time),
[in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;]
1. adverbially, before, in front: Lk 19:28; εἰς τὸ ἔ., Lk 19:4; opp. to ὄπισθεν, Re 4:6; opp. to τὰ ὀπίσω, τὰ ἔ., Phl 3:13.
2. As prep., before;
(a) in front of: Mt 5:246:27:611:1027:29, Lk 5:197:2714:2, Jo 3:2810:4, Re 19:1022:8;
(b) in the presence of: Mt 27:11, Ga 2:14, I Th 1:32:193:93:13; ὁμολουεῖν, ἀρνεῖσθαι (Dalman, Words, 210), Mt 10:32, 3326:70, Lk 12:8; in forensic sense, Mt 25:3227:11, Lk 21:36, Ac 18:17, II Co 5:10, I Th 2:19, I Jn 3:19; εὐδοκία (θέλημά) ἐστι ἔ. θεοῦ (a targumic formula; Dalman, Words, 211), Mt 11:2618:14, Lk 10:21;
(c) in the sight of: Mt 5:166:117:223:14, Mk 2:129:2, Lk 19:27, Jo 12:37, Ac 10:4;
(d) of rank and dignity (Dem., Plat., al.; LXX, Ge 48:20): Jo 1:15, 30.†

ἐμβλέπω.long: I look into (upon); met: I consider; I see clearly.
ἐμβλέπω.sd: to look on, i.e. (relatively) to observe fixedly, or (absolutely) to discern clearly
ἐμβλέπω.kj: behold, gaze up, look upon, (could) see
ἐμβλέπω.as:
ἐμ-βλέπω
[in LXX for רָאָה, III Ki 8:8, al.), פָּנָה (Jb 6:28 A, al.); metaph., Is 51:1 (נָבַט hi.), Si 2:10, etc. ;]
to look at: c. acc rei, Mk 8:25; c. dat. pers. (part., seq. λέγει, εἶπεν, cf. Xen., Cyr., i, 3, 2), Mt 19:26, Mk 10:21, 2714:67, Lk 20:1722:61 (ἐνέβλεψεν), Jo 1:36, 43; absol., to look, Ac 22:11; metaph., to consider: Mt 6:26.†

ἐμαυτοῦ.sd: of myself so likewise the dative case , and accusative case
ἐμαυτοῦ.der: genitive case compound of G1700 (ἐμοῦ) and G846 (αὐτός);
ἐμαυτοῦ.as:
ἐμαυτοῦ, -ῆς, -οῦ,
reflex pron. of first pers., used only in gen., dat. and acc sing.,
of myself: Lk 7:7, al.; ἀπ’ ἐ., Jo 5:307:17, 288:28, 4210:1814:10; ὑπ’ ἐμαυτόν, Mt 8:9, Lk 7:8

ἐμβαίνω.long: I step in; I go onboard a ship, embark.
ἐμβαίνω.sd: to walk on, i.e. embark (aboard a vessel), reach (a pool)
ἐμβαίνω.kj: come (get) into, enter (into), go (up) into, step in, take ship
ἐμβαίνω.der: from G1722 (ἐν) and the base of G939 (βάσις);
ἐμβαίνω.as:
ἐμ-βαίνω
[in LXX for עָלָה, etc. ;]
to step into: Jo 5:4 (WH, RV omit); εἰς πλοῖον, to embark: Mt 8:239:113:214:2215:39, Mk 4:15:186:458:10, 13, Lk 5:38:22, 37, Jo 6:17, 2421:3, Ac 21:6.†

ἐμβριμάομαι.long: I snort (with the notion of coercion springing out of displeasure, anger, indignation, antagonism), express indignant displeasure with some one; I charge sternly.
ἐμβριμάομαι.sd: to have indignation on, i.e. (transitively) to blame, (intransitively) to sigh with chagrin, (specially) to sternly enjoin
ἐμβριμάομαι.der: from G1722 (ἐν) and (to snort with anger);
ἐμβριμάομαι.as:
ἐμ-βριμάομαι (T, -έομαι; Bl., § 22, 1), -ῶμαι
(< βρίμη, strength, bulk, whence βριμάομαι, to snort with anger),
depon., with aor. mid. and pass.,
[in LXX (Hatch, Essays, 25): Da LXX 11:30 (also Aq., Ps 7:12; Sm., Is 17:13) * ;]
to snort in (of horses, Æsch.), hence, to speak or act with deep feeling (DCG, i, 62b);
(a)to be moved with anger (cf. ἐμβρίμημα, La 2:6): c. dat., Mk 14:5, Jo 11:33; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Jo 11:38;
(b)to admonish sternly: c. dat., Mt 9:30, Mk 1:43.†

ἐμπίπτω.g: I fall in, am cast in
ἐμπίπτω.long: I fall in, am cast in, am involved in.
ἐμπίπτω.sd: to fall on, i.e. (literally) to be entrapped by, or (figuratively) be overwhelmed with
ἐμπίπτω.as:
ἐμ-πίπτω
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
to fall into: seq. εἰς, Mt 12:11, Lk 6:3910:36; metaph., εἰς κρίμα, I Ti 3:6; ὀνειδισμόνI Ti 3:7; πειρασμόν, I Ti 6:9; εἰς χεῖρας θεοῦ (cf. II Ki 24:14, I Ch 21:13, Si 2:18), He 10:31.†

ἔμπορος.long: a merchant, trader; one on a journey.
ἔμπορος.der: from G1722 (ἐν) and the base of G4198 (πορεύομαι);
ἔμπορος.as:
ἔμ-πορος, -ου, ὁ
(< πόρος, a journey), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר, רָכַל ;]
1.a passenger on shipboard, one on a journey.
2.a merchant: Mt 13:45, Re 18:3, 11 ,15, 23.†

ἐμός.der: from the oblique cases of G1473 (ἐγώ) (G1698 (ἐμοί), G1700 (ἐμοῦ), G1691 (ἐμέ));
ἐμός.as:
ἐμός, -ή, -όν
poss. prop. of first pers., representing the em­phasized gen. ἐμοῦ,
mine, subjectively and objectively, i.e. belonging to, proceeding from or related to me: Mt 18:20, Mk 8:38, Jo 3:29 (most freq. in this gospel), al.; absol., τὸ ἐμόν, τὰ ἐμά, Mt 20:1525:27, Lk 15:31, Jo 10:1416:14, 1517:10; = gen. obj. (cl.), εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀνάμνησιν, Lk 22:19, I Co 11:24, 25; c. gen. expl., τ. ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου, I Co 16:21, Col 4:18, II Th 3:17

ἐμπορία.as:
ἐμπορία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἔμπορος), [in LXX for סָחַר, רָכַל etc. ;]
commerce, business, trade: Mt 22:5.†

ἐμπίμπρημι.long: I burn, set on fire, suffer inflammation.
ἐμπίμπρημι.sd: to enkindle, i.e. set on fire
ἐμπίμπρημι.der: from G1722 (ἐν) and (to blow a flame);
ἐμπίμπρημι.as:
ἐμ-πίπρημι,
ἐμπρήθω (for the form, v.s. ἐμπίπλημι, and cf. Veitch, s.v. πίμπρημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף ;]
to set on fire: πόλιν, Mt 22:7; pass., of the body, to become inflamed: Ac 28:6 (T; πίμπρημι WH, q.v.).†

ἐμβάπτω.sd: to whelm on, i.e. wet (a part of the person, etc.) by contact with a fluid
ἐμβάπτω.as:
* ἐμ-βάπτω
to dip in: τ. χεῖρα ἐν τ. τρυβλίῳ, Mt 26:23; mid., seq. εἰς, Mk 14:20.†

ἐμπτύω.as:
ἐμ-πτύω
[in LXX: seq. εἰς, Nu 12:14 A, De 25:9 (יָרָק)* ;]
= cl., καταπτύω (Ruth., NPhr., 66),
to spit upon: c. dat., Mk 10:3414:6515:19; seq. εἰς, Mt 26:6727:30. Pass., Lk 18:32.†

ἐμφανίζω.g: I make visible, report against, appear before
ἐμφανίζω.long: I make visible (manifest); hence: I report (inform) against; pass: I appear before.
ἐμφανίζω.sd: to exhibit (in person) or disclose (by words)
ἐμφανίζω.kj: appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify
ἐμφανίζω.as:
ἐμφανίζω
[in LXX for יָדַע hi., etc. ;]
1.to manifest, exhibit: ἐαυτόν, c. dat pers., Jo 14:21, 22 (DCG, ii, 112b). Pass. and mid., to show oneself, appear: Mt 27:53, He 9:24 (cf. MM, Exp., xii).
2.to declare, make known: seq. ὅτι, He 11:14; c. dat. pers., Ac 23:15; c acc rei, seq. πρός, Ac 23:22; κατά, c. gen. pers., Ac 24:125:2; περί, Ac 25:15.†
SYN.: δηλόω, q.v

ἐμπίμπλημι.sd: to fill in (up), i.e. (by implication) to satisfy (literally or figuratively)
ἐμπίμπλημι.der: from G1722 (ἐν) and the base of G4118 (πλεῖστος);
ἐμπίμπλημι.as:
ἐμ-πίπλημι
(on ἐμπίμπ-, v. LS, s.v., Bl., § 6, 8), and ἐμπιπλάω (Ac 14:17), [in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, שָׂבַע ;]
to fill full, fill up, satisfy: c. acc pers. et gen. rei, Lk 1:53, Ac 14:17; pass., Lk 6:25, Jo 6:12; metaph., c. gen. pers., to take one's fill of: Ro 15:24 (cf. Da LXX Su 32).†

ἐμβάλλω.sd: to throw on, i.e. (figuratively) subject to (eternal punishment)
ἐμβάλλω.as:
ἐμ-βάλλω
[in LXX for שׂוּם, etc. ;]
to cast into: seq. εἰς, Lk 12:5 (cf. MM, Exp., vii, 93).†

ἔμφοβος.as:
** ἔμ-φοβος
[in LXX: Si 19:24, I Mac 13:2 * ;]
1.terrible.
2.in fear (of Godly fear, Si 19:24), terrified: Lk 24:5, 37, Ac 10:424:25, Re 11:13.†

Ἐμμαοῦς.long: Emmaus, a village not far from Jerusalem.
Ἐμμαοῦς.as:
Ἐμμαούς, ἡ
Emmaus, a place 60 furlongs from Jerusalem: Lk 24:13.†

ἐμπόριον.long: a place of traffic, mart, market, market-house.
ἐμπόριον.as:
ἐμπόριον, -ον, τό
(ἔμπορος) [in LXX: De 33:19 (סָפַן), Ez 27:3 (רָכַל); ἐ. εἶναι, Is 23:17 (זָנָה)* ;]
a trading place, exchange: οἶκος ἐμπορίου, Jo 2:16.†

ἐμφυσάω.as:
ἐμ-φυσάω, -ῶ
(< φυσάω, to blow), [in LXX for נָפַח, etc. ;]
to breathe into (cf. Ge 2:7, Wi 15:11, a1.), breathe upon: Jo 20:22.†

Ἑμμώρ.long: Hamor, a man whose sons sold a field at Shechem to Jacob.
Ἑμμώρ.as:
Ἑμμώρ (T, Ἐμμώρ, Rec. -όρ indecl. (Heb. חֲמוֹר),
Emmor (Ge 33:19): Ac 7:16.†

ἐμπνέω.sd: to inhale, i.e. (figuratively) to be animated by (bent upon)

ἐμφανής.der: from a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G5316 (φαίνω);
ἐμφανής.as:
ἐμφανής, -ές
(< ἐμφαίνω, to show in, exhibit), [in LXX: Mi 4:1, Is 2:2 (כּוּן ni.), Wi 6:227:2114:17; ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Ex 2:14 (יָדַע ni.), Is 65:1 (דָּרַשׁ ni.)* ;]
manifest: Ac 10:40; metaph., Ro 10:20(LXX) (v.s. ἐπιφανής).†

ἐμμένω.g: I remain or abide in, abide by, maintain
ἐμμένω.long: I remain (abide) in, abide by, maintain, persevere in.
ἐμμένω.sd: to stay in the same place, i.e. (figuratively) persevere
ἐμμένω.as:
ἐμμένω
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
1.to abide in: Ac 28:30.
2.to abide by, be true to: seq. ἐν; τ. πίστει, Ac 14:22; τ. διαθήκῃ, He 8:9(LXX); c. dat., τ. γεγραμμένοις (dat. ptcp. as in legal formula; cf. Deiss., BS, 248; MM, Exp., xii): Ga 3:10(LXX).†

ἐμμαίνομαι.sd: to rave on, i.e. rage at
ἐμμαίνομαι.as:
*† ἐμ-μαίνομαι depon.,
to rage against: c. dat., Ac 26:11.†

ἐμβιβάζω.long: trans: I embark, put on board, step into.
ἐμβιβάζω.sd: causative of G1684 (ἐμβαίνω)); to place on, i.e. transfer (aboard a vessel)
ἐμβιβάζω.as:
ἐμ-βιβάζω
[in LXX: IV Ki 9:23 (רָכַב hi.), Pr 4:11 (דָּרַךְ hi.) * ;]
1.to set in, put in.
2.to put on board ship, embark: c. acc pers., seq. εἰς, Ac 27:6.†

ἐμπεριπατέω.g: I walk about in a place
ἐμπεριπατέω.long: I walk about in a place, live among, am conversant with.
ἐμπεριπατέω.sd: to perambulate on a place, i.e. (figuratively) to be occupied among persons

ἐμβατεύω.long: I enter, set foot on, intrude, pry into.
ἐμβατεύω.sd: equivalent to G1684 (ἐμβαίνω); to intrude on (figuratively)
ἐμβατεύω.der: from G1722 (ἐν) and a presumed derivative of the base of G939 (βάσις);
ἐμβατεύω.as:
ἐμβατεύω
[in LXX: c. acc, Jos 19:49 (נָחַל, Jos 19:51 (חָלַק pi.); seq. εἰς, I Mac 12:2513:2014:3115:40; metaph., II Mac 2:30 * ;] (< ἐμβάτης < ἐμβαίνω)
1.to step in or on (Soph.), hence
(a)to frequent, haunt, dwell in (Æsch., Eur.); metaph., Col 2:18 (dwelling in, R, txt.; taking, R, mg.);
(b)to invade (1Mac, ll c.; metaph., Col, l.c.).
2.to enter on, come into possession of (Eur., Dem.; LXX, Jos, ll. c.); on the difficulties of reading and interpretation in this passage, v. Lft, Col., 194 f., 252; ICC, 268 ff.; Field, Notes, 197; Milligan, NTD, 177; and for exx. from π., MM, Exp., xii (cf. κενεμβ.).†

ἐμπλέκομαι.long: I enfold, entangle; pass: I am involved in.
ἐμπλέκομαι.as:
ἐμ-πλέκω
[in LXX: Pr 28:18 (נָפַל), II Mac 15:17 * ;]
to weave in, entwine; pass., metaph., to be involved, entangled in: II Ti 2:4, II Pe 2:20.†

ἐμπαιγμός.as:
† ἐμ-παιγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ἐμπαίζω, q.v.), [in LXX: Ez 22:4 (קַלָּסָה), Ps 38:7 B א1קלה ni.), Wi 12:2, Si 27:28, II Mac 7:7, III Mac 5:22 * ;]
a mocking: He 11:36.†

ἔμφυτος.long: inborn, ingrown, congenital, natural, rooted, implanted.
ἔμφυτος.der: from G1722 (ἐν) and a derivative of G5453 (φύω);
ἔμφυτος.as:
** ἔμ-φυτος, -ον
(< ἐμφύω, to implant), [in LXX: ἔ. ἡ κακία αὐτῶν, Wi 12:10 * ;]
1.innate (Wi 12:10).
2.rooted, implanted: Ja 1:21 (v. Mayor, in l).†

ἐμπορεύομαι.g: I travel as a merchant, engage in trade
ἐμπορεύομαι.long: I travel as a merchant, engage in trade; I traffic in, make gain or business of.
ἐμπορεύομαι.sd: to travel in (a country as a pedlar), i.e. (by implication) to trade
ἐμπορεύομαι.as:
ἐμ-πορεύομαι depon.
(< ἔμπορος), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר ;]
1.to travel, esp. for business.
2.to traffic, trade: Ja 4:13.
3. C. acc rei
(a)to traffic in;
(b)to import: (Ho 12:1, for יָבַל hoph.).
4. C. acc pers., to make a gain of: II Pe 2:3.†

ἐμπλοκή.as:
*† ἐμ-πλοκή, ῆς, ἡ
(< ἐμπλίκω),
a braiding: τριχῶν, I Pe 3:3.†

ἐμπαιγμονή.as:
*† ἐμπαιγμονή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< ἐμπαίζω, q.v.),
mockery: II Pe 3:3.†

ἐμπαίκτης.sd: a derider, i.e. (by implication) a false teacher
ἐμπαίκτης.as:
† ἐμ-παίκτης, -ου, ὁ
(< ἐμπαίζω, q.v.), [in LXX: Is 3:4 (ִתַּעֲלוּלִים) * ;]
a mocker: II Pe 3:3, Ju 18.†

ἐμέω.as:
ἐμέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Is 19:14 (קֵא)* ;]
to vomit: fig., Re 3:16.†
